systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

denyAssignmentName.Description: The display name of the deny assignment.

description.Description: The description of the deny assignment.

permissions.Description: An array of permissions that are denied by the deny assignment.

doNotApplyToChildScopes.Description: Determines if the deny assignment applies to child scopes. Default value is false.

principals.Description: Array of principals to which the deny assignment applies.

excludePrincipals.Description: Array of principals to which the deny assignment does not apply.

isSystemProtected.Description: Specifies whether this deny assignment was created by Azure and cannot be edited or deleted.

denyAssignmentEffect.Description: The effect of the deny assignment. 'enforced' blocks access, 'audit' logs without blocking.

condition.Description: The conditions on the deny assignment. This limits the resources it can be assigned to. e.g.: @Resource[Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers:ContainerName] StringEqualsIgnoreCase 'foo_storage_container'

createdBy.Description: Id of the user who created the assignment

updatedBy.Description: Id of the user who updated the assignment

actions.Description: Actions to which the deny assignment does not grant access.

notActions.Description: Actions to exclude from that the deny assignment does not grant access.

dataActions.Description: Data actions to which the deny assignment does not grant access.

notDataActions.Description: Data actions to exclude from that the deny assignment does not grant access.

condition.Description: The conditions on the Deny assignment permission. This limits the resources it applies to.

id.Description: The object ID of the principal.

type.Description: The type of the principal such as user, group, servicePrincipal, etc.

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)
